---
title: "UEFA Europa Conference League"
format:
  html:
    page-layout: full
    toc: false
    html-table-processing: none
---

Player leaderboards for the UEFA Europa Conference League — minutes played, goals,
and assists across every player in the competition. Stats are aggregated
from completed matches and refresh automatically every day.

```{=html}
<style>
  .conf-wrap { --conf-card-bg:#fff; --conf-card-br:#e6e8eb; --conf-muted:#6b7280;
             --conf-accent:#00a94f; --conf-chip:#eef2f7;
             --conf-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.08); color:#1f2937; margin-top:.5rem; }
  .conf-meta { color:var(--conf-muted); font-size:.85rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; }
  .conf-tabs { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.4rem; margin-bottom:1.25rem; }
  .conf-tab { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.4rem; cursor:pointer;
            border:1px solid var(--conf-card-br); background:var(--conf-card-bg);
            border-radius:999px; padding:.35rem .8rem; font-size:.9rem; line-height:1;
            transition:all .12s ease; color:inherit; }
  .conf-tab:hover { border-color:var(--conf-accent); }
  .conf-tab.active { background:var(--conf-accent); border-color:var(--conf-accent); color:#fff; }
  .conf-tab .crest { width:1.15em; height:1.15em; object-fit:contain; }
  .conf-tab .flag { width:1.2em; height:1.2em; object-fit:contain; }
  .conf-modes { display:inline-flex; gap:.25rem; margin-bottom:.8rem; padding:.2rem;
             background:var(--conf-chip); border-radius:999px; }
  .conf-mode { border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer; border-radius:999px;
             padding:.3rem .85rem; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--conf-muted); font-weight:600; }
  .conf-mode.active { background:var(--conf-card-bg); color:var(--conf-accent);
             box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.12); }
  .conf-boards { display:grid; gap:1.25rem; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(300px,1fr)); align-items:start; }
  .conf-board { background:var(--conf-card-bg); border:1px solid var(--conf-card-br);
              border-radius:14px; box-shadow:var(--conf-shadow); overflow:hidden; }
  .conf-board h3 { margin:0; padding:.8rem 1rem; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600;
                 border-bottom:1px solid var(--conf-card-br); display:flex; align-items:baseline; gap:.5rem; }
  .conf-board h3 .count { color:var(--conf-muted); font-weight:400; font-size:.8rem; }
  .conf-table { width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; font-size:.88rem; }
  .conf-table td { padding:.42rem .6rem; border-top:1px solid #f1f3f6; vertical-align:middle; }
  .conf-table tr:first-child td { border-top:none; }
  .conf-table tr:hover td { background:#f8fafc; }
  .conf-rank { width:2rem; text-align:right; color:var(--conf-muted); font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .conf-headshot { width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:#f1f3f6;
                 object-fit:cover; display:block; }
  .conf-initials { width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--conf-chip);
                 color:var(--conf-muted); font-size:.66rem; font-weight:600;
                 display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
  .conf-player { line-height:1.15; }
  .conf-player .nm { font-weight:600; }
  .conf-player .tm { color:var(--conf-muted); font-size:.76rem; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.3rem; }
  .conf-crest { width:1.05em; height:1.05em; object-fit:contain; }
  .conf-val { text-align:right; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .conf-sub { text-align:right; color:var(--conf-muted); font-size:.76rem; white-space:nowrap;
            font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }
  .conf-more { display:block; width:100%; border:none; background:none; cursor:pointer;
             padding:.6rem; font-size:.82rem; color:var(--conf-accent); font-weight:600;
             border-top:1px solid var(--conf-card-br); }
  .conf-more:hover { background:#f8fafc; }
  .conf-medal { margin-right:.2rem; }
  .conf-loading, .conf-error { color:var(--conf-muted); padding:2rem 0; }
</style>

<div class="conf-wrap">
  <div class="conf-meta" id="conf-meta"></div>
  <div class="conf-modes" id="conf-modes">
    <button class="conf-mode active" data-mode="club">By club</button>
    <button class="conf-mode" data-mode="nation">By nation</button>
  </div>
  <div class="conf-tabs" id="conf-tabs"></div>
  <div id="conf-boards"><div class="conf-loading">Loading leaderboards…</div></div>
</div>

<script>
(function () {
  const TOP = 25;
  const MEDAL = { 0:"🥇", 1:"🥈", 2:"🥉" };
  const LOGO = (id) => `https://a.espncdn.com/i/teamlogos/soccer/500/${id}.png`;

  const esc = (s) => String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g, c =>
    ({"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;","\"":"&quot;"}[c]));
  const initials = (n) => n.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean).slice(0,2).map(w=>w[0]).join("").toUpperCase();

  const photo = (p) => p.img
    ? `<img loading="lazy" class="conf-headshot" src="${esc(p.img)}" alt=""
         onerror="this.outerHTML='<span class=&quot;conf-initials&quot;>${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>'">`
    : `<span class="conf-initials">${esc(initials(p.name))}</span>`;

  const crest = (id) => id
    ? `<img class="conf-crest" src="${esc(LOGO(id))}" alt="" loading="lazy"
         onerror="this.style.display='none'">`
    : "";

  function row(p, i, val, sub) {
    const medal = i < 3 ? `<span class="conf-medal">${MEDAL[i]}</span>` : "";
    return `<tr>
      <td class="conf-rank">${i + 1}</td>
      <td style="width:34px">${photo(p)}</td>
      <td class="conf-player"><div class="nm">${esc(p.name)}</div>
        <div class="tm">${crest(p.team_id)}${esc(p.team)}</div></td>
      <td class="conf-val">${medal}${val}</td>
      <td class="conf-sub">${sub}</td>
    </tr>`;
  }

  function board(el, title, unit, players, val, sub) {
    let shown = TOP;
    const render = () => {
      el.innerHTML = `<h3>${title}<span class="count">${players.length} players</span></h3>
        <table class="conf-table"><tbody>
          ${players.slice(0, shown).map((p,i) => row(p, i, val(p), sub(p))).join("")}
        </tbody></table>
        ${shown < players.length
          ? `<button class="conf-more">Show all ${players.length}</button>`
          : players.length > TOP ? `<button class="conf-more">Show top ${TOP}</button>` : ""}`;
      const btn = el.querySelector(".conf-more");
      if (btn) btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
        shown = shown < players.length ? players.length : TOP; render();
      });
    };
    render();
  }

  const by = (...keys) => (a, b) => {
    for (const k of keys) { if (a[k] !== b[k]) return b[k] - a[k]; }
    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name);
  };

  function renderBoards(players) {
    const host = document.getElementById("conf-boards");
    host.innerHTML = `<div class="conf-boards">
      <div class="conf-board" id="conf-mins"></div>
      <div class="conf-board" id="conf-goals"></div>
      <div class="conf-board" id="conf-assists"></div></div>`;
    board(document.getElementById("conf-mins"), "Minutes", "mins",
      [...players].sort(by("mins", "apps", "goals")),
      p => `${p.mins}′`, p => `${p.apps} apps · ${p.goals}g ${p.assists}a`);
    board(document.getElementById("conf-goals"), "Goals", "goals",
      players.filter(p => p.goals > 0).sort(by("goals", "assists")),
      p => p.goals, p => `${p.assists}a · ${p.apps} apps`);
    board(document.getElementById("conf-assists"), "Assists", "assists",
      players.filter(p => p.assists > 0).sort(by("assists", "goals")),
      p => p.assists, p => `${p.goals}g · ${p.apps} apps`);
  }

  let allPlayers = [];
  let mode = "club";

  const MODES = {
    club:   { key: "team",   img: p => LOGO(p.team_id), cls: "crest" },
    nation: { key: "nation", img: p => p.nation_flag,   cls: "flag" },
  };

  function buildTabs() {
    const tabsEl = document.getElementById("conf-tabs");
    const m = MODES[mode];
    const groups = new Map();
    for (const p of allPlayers) {
      const v = p[m.key];
      if (v && !groups.has(v)) groups.set(v, m.img(p));
    }
    const keys = [...groups.keys()].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
    const tab = (label, src, value, active) =>
      `<span class="conf-tab${active ? " active" : ""}" data-value="${esc(value)}">` +
      `${src ? `<img class="${m.cls}" src="${esc(src)}" alt="" onerror="this.style.display='none'">` : ""}${esc(label)}</span>`;
    tabsEl.innerHTML = tab("All", "", "", true) +
      keys.map(k => tab(k, groups.get(k), k, false)).join("");
  }

  function applyFilter(value) {
    const key = MODES[mode].key;
    renderBoards(value ? allPlayers.filter(p => p[key] === value) : allPlayers);
  }

  function initControls() {
    const modesEl = document.getElementById("conf-modes");
    const tabsEl = document.getElementById("conf-tabs");
    modesEl.addEventListener("click", e => {
      const b = e.target.closest(".conf-mode"); if (!b) return;
      modesEl.querySelectorAll(".conf-mode").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
      b.classList.add("active");
      mode = b.dataset.mode;
      buildTabs();
      applyFilter("");
    });
    tabsEl.addEventListener("click", e => {
      const t = e.target.closest(".conf-tab"); if (!t) return;
      tabsEl.querySelectorAll(".conf-tab").forEach(x => x.classList.remove("active"));
      t.classList.add("active");
      applyFilter(t.dataset.value);
    });
  }

  fetch("assets/conference/stats.json?v=" + Date.now())
    .then(r => { if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status); return r.json(); })
    .then(data => {
      allPlayers = data.players || [];
      document.getElementById("conf-meta").textContent =
        `Updated ${data.updated || ""} · ${data.matches} matches played · ${allPlayers.length} players`;
      initControls();
      buildTabs();
      renderBoards(allPlayers);
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById("conf-boards").innerHTML =
        `<div class="conf-error">Couldn't load stats (${esc(err.message)}).</div>`;
    });
})();
</script>
```
